question: Who became the first athlete to break a national record at the Khelo India Para Games 2025 by lifting 101 kg in the 45 kg category powerlifting in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaspreet Kaur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jaspreet Kaur** made history in the **2025 Khelo India Para Games** by becoming the first athlete to break a **national record** in the competition.
 
• She achieved this remarkable feat by lifting **101 kg** in the **45 kg powerlifting category**, setting a new milestone in the sport.
 
• The event was held in **March 2025**, and Jaspreet Kaur’s achievement was widely celebrated as a testament to perseverance and dedication. *Hence, the correct answer is Jaspreet Kaur.*
